title: Pop Punk
tagline: Fast punk energy paired with melodic hooks and shout-along choruses.
summary: Pop punk combines punk's speed and directness with concise melodies and catchy choruses. It developed through independent scenes before reaching a wider audience in successive waves. The style ranges from raw and scrappy to polished, but keeps short songs, energetic performance, and youthful perspective close to its center.

pillars.name: Buzzcocks
pillars.why: Buzzcocks paired punk's urgency with sharp pop melodies and helped establish a lasting template.

pillars.name: The Ramones
pillars.why: The Ramones' short, direct songs provided a foundational model for melodic punk bands.

pillars.name: Green Day
pillars.why: Green Day brought a highly melodic punk sound to a large international audience in the 1990s.
